_comment: All infra_audit settings. Relative paths are resolved against this file's folder. Keys starting with _ are notes and are ignored.

sending_domains.label: Google Workspace (5 mailboxes) + Brevo
sending_domains._resend_note: Resend records (resend._domainkey, send MX/TXT, dc-fd741b8612._spfm.send) were leftovers: blossomstreetventures.com isn't a Resend domain. Removed 2026-10-30.
sending_domains._dkim_rotation_note: Rotated from the 1024-bit 'google' selector to 2048-bit 'google2026' on 2026-10-27. Delete the old google._domainkey TXT record in GoDaddy after ~2026-11-03.

cname_hosts._comment: Hostnames checked for dangling CNAMEs (target no longer resolves = takeover risk). Value is a short note shown in the report.
cname_hosts.sable._domainkey.blossomstreetventures.c: legacy GoDaddy Email Marketing DKIM (not used)
cname_hosts.bounces.em.blossomstreetventures.com: legacy GoDaddy Email Marketing bounces (not used)

_starttls_note: Off because your ISP blocks outbound port 25 (every attempt timed out). Google's MX certificates are managed by Google; turn this on only from a network that allows port 25.
_allowed_filter_terms_note: Filters whose criteria contain one of these (case, spaces and quotes ignored, so DylanLane / "Dylan Lane" / Hi Dylanlane all match) may archive, delete or spam mail without a WARN. A filter that FORWARDS is still checked against allowed_forwarding.

google._scopes_note: gmail.readonly is already authorized for this service account (HardBounceCheck / Engagement-Tracker). The Admin SDK checks need admin.directory.user.readonly, which is NOT authorized yet. Set directory_scope_approved to true only after you add that scope in Admin console > Security > API controls > Domain-wide delegation.

network._dns_note: Leave dns_nameservers empty to use your system resolver. Do NOT set 8.8.8.8/1.1.1.1: Spamhaus and URIBL refuse queries from big public resolvers and the reputation checks will ERROR.
